author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be Ubisoft's value hitting rock bottom to the point where the company is in the worst state it's been in quite a while. This all could have been avoided if they just listened to gamers but even now they still choose to burn what little they have left. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Ubisoft Is Basically Dead Now...
